plain: Great force or strength of feeling

webster.text: Violence; great force; properly, force derived from velocity; as the vehemence of wind.

example.quote: With respect to disputes between a state and the citizens of another state, its jurisdiction has been decried with unusual vehemence.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 20, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
